points.label: Points per game
points.help: Average points scored (offense) or allowed (defense) per game. A lower defensive rank means fewer points allowed.

totalYards.label: Total yards per game
totalYards.help: Scrimmage yards per game. Offense wants more. Defense wants fewer yards allowed.

passYards.label: Pass yards per game
passYards.help: Net passing yards per game. The defensive number is yards allowed through the air.

rushYards.label: Rush yards per game
rushYards.help: Rushing yards per game. The defensive number is rushing yards allowed.

yardsPerRush.label: Yards per rush
yardsPerRush.help: Average yards gained each rushing attempt. Efficiency, not volume.

thirdDown.label: 3rd down %
thirdDown.help: Share of third downs converted. Defense is the share allowed to opponents.

fourthDown.label: 4th down %
fourthDown.help: Share of fourth downs converted. Defense is the share allowed to opponents.

redZone.label: Red zone scoring %
redZone.help: How often a team scores once it reaches the opponent's 20-yard line. Defense is how often opponents score.

giveaways.label: Giveaways per game
giveaways.help: Turnovers lost per game. Fewer is better.

takeaways.label: Takeaways per game
takeaways.help: Turnovers created per game. More is better.

sacks.label: Sacks per game
sacks.help: Sacks recorded by the defense per game.

tfl.label: Tackles for loss per game
tfl.help: Tackles for loss by the defense per game.

top.label: Time of possession
top.help: Minutes of possession per game. This is the offense's share of the clock, shown as minutes.

penalties.label: Penalties per game
penalties.help: Penalties called on the team per game. Fewer is better.

sos.label: Strength of schedule
sos.help: Average winning percentage of opponents so far. An FCS opponent counts as a .400 win percentage. Higher means a harder schedule. This is record-based, not an SP+ rating.

ats.label: ATS record
ats.help: Against the spread: wins, losses, and pushes versus the closing line. The rank uses cover percentage, pushes excluded. A line appears only when these two teams are scheduled to play.
